description: ai_structured — Structured extraction with YOUR schema: turn any text into a JSON object that matches a JSON Schema (or shorthand like name:string,amount:number,due:date,tags:string[],status:open|closed). Unknown values come back null (no guessing); output is validated offline (types, enum, required, min/max, lengths, items, date/email formats), numeric/boolean strings are coerced, and the model gets one automatic retry with the errors. text= and schema= required (text up to 12000 chars, 60 properties). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
